verdict.rationale: Dev-handoff inspection is a fair axis for a web-based design tool, but the evidence never describes an inspect or dev mode that shows per-layer measurements, styles, assets, or CSS/iOS/Android snippets, nor any viewer-seat access. The documented code export (Vanilla JS, Three.js, React, Next.js, react-three-fiber) produces whole-scene runtime code rather than per-layer handoff snippets, and it appears among paid plan features, so it does not satisfy this story.
